insight: Founded in 2018 by Andrew Maximov, former Technical Art Director at Naughty Dog; a Disney Accelerator alum used by PlayStation Studios.
name: Promethean AI
tagline: AI assistant that builds and dresses 3D game environments.
description: An AI assistant for professional game artists and environment designers that reasons over a studio's own asset library to generate, populate, and dress complex 3D scenes. It runs inside existing editors via plugins for Unreal Engine, Unity, 3ds Max, Maya, and Blender — and works without uploading assets to the cloud. Rather than generating images, it automates the repetitive placement and worldbuilding work behind large productions.
